key_concepts: Atoms have a central nucleus containing protons and neutrons
Electrons are found in electron shells surrounding the nucleus
Protons are positively charged particles with a mass of about 1 atomic mass unit
Neutrons are neutral particles with a mass of about 1 atomic mass unit
Electrons are negatively charged particles with a very small mass, about 1/1836 of an atom
The number of protons determines the element and its atomic number
Neutrons help stabilize the nucleus by reducing repulsive forces between protons
